name: Fish Audio
summary: Text-to-speech and voice cloning platform with emotion control and a large voice library.
description: Fish Audio provides text-to-speech and voice cloning with emotion control, a library of more than two million community voices and a developer API. Its Drama model targets expressive real-time speech. The Free tier includes 8,000 credits per month without a card; paid tiers include Plus, Pro at $75 per month billed annually and Max for teams, with commercial use on paid plans.
